case_name: LESTER BRETT MARK ANTHONY ROBINSON v A-Z RIGGING AND SCAFFOLDING LIMITED and DUDLEY REX HOSKIN
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [61](b) Lester Robinson was unjustifiably dismissed from his employment with A-Z Rigging and Scaffolding Limited.
review_notes: Direct review of findings and outcome. The redundancy was commercially genuine and substantively available, but the consultation/process failure made the dismissal unjustified.
remedies_awarded: $4,410 gross lost wages; $5,000 s 123(1)(c)(i) compensation; separate $20 Wages Protection Act repayment.

case_name: MORTEZA SHARIFI v CAREER MATRIX NZ LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Career Matrix has failed to discharge its onus of establishing that its dismissal of Mr Sharifi on the grounds of redundancy was procedurally or substantively justified.
review_notes: Direct review of redundancy findings, selection/redeployment analysis, remedies and contribution. Both substantive and procedural justification failed.

case_name: MIJ v KZT
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The Authority found only an arguable case for unjustified dismissal and made an interim reinstatement order on untested affidavit evidence.
review_notes: Interim reinstatement determination; substantive dismissal merits were not finally determined.
remedies_awarded: No final dismissal-merits remedy; interim reinstatement only.

case_name: WILLIAM TELFORD v SGS NEW ZEALAND LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: I conclude that it is not just for Mr Telford to be able to raise his grievance out of time.
review_notes: Leave to raise the dismissal grievance out of time was declined; dismissal merits were not reached.

case_name: ASHLEY NICKLIN v J K J OBORN LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Oborn was ordered to pay reimbursement of lost remuneration as a result of Mr Nicklin's grievance for unjustified dismissal.
review_notes: Direct review confirms the dismissal grievance succeeded and dismissal remedies were ordered.
remedies_awarded: Lost remuneration and compensation ordered for unjustified dismissal, plus separate holiday-pay arrears.

case_name: PAULA CARSTENSEN v LAKES DISTRICT HEALTH BOARD
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination addressed the statutory three-year bar and the Authority's jurisdiction to extend time.
review_notes: Jurisdiction/time-limit determination only; no dismissal merits finding.

case_name: ETHAN KARLOS HARDY v BOUTIQUE RENOVATIONS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: I consider Mr Hardy was constructively dismissed and in the circumstances as set out above, it was unjustified.
review_notes: Express successful constructive-dismissal finding.

case_name: HARPREET SINGH First v JASWINDER SINGH Second Applicant AND SRI GURU SINGH SABHA AUCKLAND INC
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination dealt with an application for a stay and compliance with an earlier determination; costs were reserved.
review_notes: Enforcement/compliance follow-up, not the underlying dismissal merits decision.

case_name: MATTHEW RICHARD EUSTON v MOORE DECORATING LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [36] Moore Decorating unjustifiably dismissed Mr Euston and in satisfaction of this grievance it must pay remedies.
review_notes: Express successful dismissal finding; direct second pass also confirmed no s 124 reduction.

case_name: EVAN HARVEY v INFRACORE LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: A case management conference was to be set to investigate Mr Harvey's substantive claim after the preliminary timing issues.
review_notes: Preliminary timeliness/leave determination; substantive dismissal merits remained for later investigation.

case_name: MELISSA JEAN OPAI v THE COMMISSIONER OF POLICE
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination resolved unjustified disadvantage grievances and related remedies; it did not determine a dismissal grievance.
review_notes: No dismissal or constructive-dismissal merits claim was decided.

case_name: KAREN LEONARD v FASTWAY GLOBAL LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: I accept Ms Leonard's claim to have been constructively dismissed.
review_notes: Constructive-dismissal grievance succeeded; contribution and remedies reviewed directly.
remedies_awarded: Constructive-dismissal remedies awarded after a 4% contribution finding.

case_name: TRISTAN SMITH v SCOTT MICKLESON T/A TOI TOI FARMS
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The dismissal is both substantively and procedurally unjustified.
review_notes: Express successful dismissal finding. Serious-misconduct wording was reviewed and did not establish a separate Authority finding of serious misconduct.

case_name: ANDREAS JOE v JUKEN NEW ZEALAND LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination records that there was no dismissal and no dismissal grievance had ever been raised.
review_notes: Claims concerned contract/disadvantage and jurisdiction, not dismissal merits.

case_name: CHRISTOPHER MILLER v SALT SEARCH NZ LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Costs are reserved pending resolution of the substantive dismissal grievance.
review_notes: Joinder/respondent correction only; substantive dismissal grievance remained unresolved.

case_name: CLEMENT BRIAN LIVINGSTONE v DOWNER NEW ZEALAND LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [36] Mr Livingstone's dismissal was substantively justified but Downer failed to meet its obligations regarding redeployment.
review_notes: Dismissal itself was expressly justified; the successful finding was instead unjustified disadvantage over redeployment. Direct second review preserved the legal/monetary distinction.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedy; separate disadvantage remedies were considered.

case_name: EUGENE JOHN DeMARCO v THE VINTAGE AVIATOR LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination dealt with non-publication and closure of the file rather than deciding dismissal merits.
review_notes: Procedural/non-publication determination; no operative dismissal merits finding.

case_name: MARK SCHOLLUM v INTERNATIONAL EDUCATION GROUP (NZ) LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination addressed unjustified disadvantage, a final warning, wage arrears and related remedies.
review_notes: No dismissal or constructive-dismissal merits determination.

supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [160] The applications of Ms Neil and Ms West to the Authority are declined. They do not have personal grievances for unjustified disadvantage and unjustified dismissal.
review_notes: Express rejection of the dismissal grievances. The Authority specifically distinguished incompatibility from a serious-misconduct dismissal.

case_name: LINARA GAFIATULLINA v PROPELLERHEAD LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The Authority did not find PL acted unjustifiably in its decision to dismiss Ms Gafiatullina on redundancy grounds; her personal grievance application is dismissed.
review_notes: Dismissal grievance failed after direct review of redundancy rationale, selection and redeployment.

case_name: MIKYUNG KIM v DOLLAR KING LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Ms Kim's constructive dismissal application is declined; the employer's conduct was not repudiatory or dismissive enough to justify termination.
review_notes: Constructive-dismissal grievance failed. Serious-misconduct allegations in the disciplinary history were separately reviewed and were not used to classify dismissal merits.

case_name: LEIGH DUNN v AIR NEW ZEALAND LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Ms Dunn's claims concerned unjustified disadvantage and good faith; her application for remedies was declined.
review_notes: No dismissal or constructive-dismissal merits determination.

case_name: RAIL AND MARITIME TRANSPORT UNION INCORPORATED v NORTH TUGZ LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination concerns compliance of a collective agreement availability provision with ss 67C and 67D of the Act.
review_notes: Collective-agreement interpretation matter; no dismissal merits determination.

case_name: BENJAMIN EDA v AORERE COLLEGE BOARD OF TRUSTEES
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The Authority had no jurisdiction over the 2017 ending because it was out of time and no jurisdiction over the 2018 ending because it was resolved in mediation.
review_notes: Dismissal-ending claims were barred by timing/settlement; successful findings concerned fixed-term statutory breaches and disadvantage, not dismissal merits.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal-merits remedy; separate disadvantage compensation was ordered.

case_name: YOUNG GOO KANG v KYOUNG YONG LEE
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination addressed alleged wages, PAYE, holiday pay and leave to bring a claim against Mr Lee.
review_notes: No dismissal or constructive-dismissal merits determination.

case_name: CARL ELLISH v NETWORK SERVICE PROVIDERS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [86] In all the circumstances I determine that Mr Ellish's employment with NSP ended by way of mutual consent.
review_notes: The alleged dismissal was rejected; employment ended by mutual agreement.

case_name: TALENT PROPELLER LIMITED v YJL
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The application for compliance order is declined and the parties would later be contacted to investigate the balance of the application and YJL's personal grievance.
review_notes: Compliance application only; personal-grievance merits were reserved for later investigation.

case_name: SOLOMON TAPUTORO v HEALTHCARE HORIZONS LIMITED (in liquidation)
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [16] I find that Mr Taputoro was constructively dismissed by Horizons due to a serious breach of duty which completely repudiated his employment.
review_notes: Constructive dismissal was found and remedies were awarded for the unjustified dismissal grievance; second review confirmed no contribution.
remedies_awarded: Lost wages and compensation ordered for unjustified constructive dismissal.

case_name: IAE First v ECI Second Applicant AND RMW Third Applicant AND TCA Fourth Applicant AND WAIRARAPA DISTRICT HEALTH BOARD
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination concerns interim reinstatement on untested affidavit evidence and states costs are best left until after the substantive investigation.
review_notes: Interim reinstatement determination; no final dismissal merits finding.

case_name: CHRISTINE CROSSEN v YANG HOUSE LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: All claims against Yang House were settled by the record of settlement.
review_notes: The record of settlement barred the claims; dismissal merits were not determined.

case_name: JAMES PARTICK STEWART v AFFCO NEW ZEALAND LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: AFFCO could renew its jurisdiction argument after evidence was filed and costs were best dealt with after determination of the substantive grievance.
review_notes: Preliminary jurisdiction determination on disadvantage claims; no dismissal merits decision.

supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Mr Burton was covered by a valid trial period and prevented from bringing an unjustifiable dismissal claim; Ms Burton's casual arrangement could cease without this being dismissal.
review_notes: The determination finally rejected the dismissal claims on employer-side grounds; each claimant's dismissal issue was reviewed separately.

case_name: SHAYNE ALBERT McCORMICK v PACIFIC AUTO PARTS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: It follows that he had not established an unjustified dismissal personal grievance.
review_notes: The Authority was not persuaded Mr McCormick had been dismissed; dismissal grievance failed.

case_name: SHONA DEAN v STEVEN RAVENWOOD AND TANIA JOHNATHON TRADING AS STEVE RAVENWOOD SERVICES
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Ms Dean was an independent contractor and the Authority has no jurisdiction to investigate and determine her claims.
review_notes: Employee status failed, so constructive-dismissal merits were not reached.

case_name: KYLE SCIASCIA v WHOLESALE CARS DIRECT (2017) LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: This order replaces the lost-wages order in the Authority's 29 June 2020 determination; the compensation order is unchanged.
review_notes: Remedy recalculation follow-up to the underlying merits determination, not a new merits decision.

case_name: FDS v YEALANDS ESTATE WINES LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: FDS is unsuccessful with his application to set aside the s 149 settlement and continue to pursue his claim of unjustifiable dismissal.
review_notes: Settlement-bar follow-up; dismissal merits were not reopened or determined.

case_name: MIJ v KZT LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: KZT Limited is ordered to pay compensation in the combined figure of $25,000 for the unjustified disadvantage and dismissal.
review_notes: The dismissal grievance succeeded and dismissal remedies were ordered.
remedies_awarded: $25,442.76 gross lost wages, Kiwisaver/holiday-pay benefits and $25,000 combined compensation for disadvantage and dismissal.

case_name: LANCE GUSH v NEW ZEALAND STEEL LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The determination resolved non-appointment and unjustified-disadvantage issues and awarded remedies for successful disadvantage grievances.
review_notes: No dismissal or constructive-dismissal merits determination.

case_name: JOHN FLETCHER v PARKVALE MUSHROOMS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Having found that Mr Fletcher was dismissed, no justification was proffered for the dismissal which I find unjustified.
review_notes: Express successful dismissal finding; direct second review confirmed no contribution.

case_name: ADAM PICKERING v PROJECT WORX 2020 LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Project Worx's summary dismissal of Mr Pickering was procedurally and substantively unjustified.
review_notes: Express successful dismissal finding. Serious-misconduct wording was second-reviewed; the Authority said it was not clear Mr Pickering had engaged in serious misconduct warranting summary dismissal.
remedies_awarded: Lost remuneration and $12,000 compensation ordered for unjustified dismissal.

case_name: RIO NGAWAKA v GLOBAL SECURITY SOLUTIONS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: [67] Mr Ngawaka was not constructively dismissed.
review_notes: Constructive-dismissal grievance failed. Employer allegations included serious misconduct, but the Authority did not need to make a final serious-misconduct finding to reject constructive dismissal.

case_name: MARGRET ADDY v THE GREAT ADVENTURE TOURISM COMPANY LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Ms Addy did not raise a personal grievance for unjustified action or unjustified dismissal within the statutory 90-day period; costs were reserved until after the substantive matter.
review_notes: Preliminary timeliness determination only; substantive merits were not decided.

case_name: SHELLEY STENHOUSE v TOWMAN TOWING GROUP LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Towman's dismissal of Ms Stenhouse was justified. Ms Stenhouse does not have a personal grievance for unjustified dismissal.
review_notes: Express employer-side dismissal merits finding. Direct second review confirmed Towman could reasonably find serious misconduct and the dismissal was procedurally and substantively justified.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedies; separate disadvantage compensation/penalty findings existed.

case_name: KIMIORA GREY v NOSTRO VIAGGIO LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Nostro Viaggio unjustifiably disadvantaged Ms Grey and failed to pay wages and holiday entitlements.
review_notes: The claims determined were disadvantage and wage/minimum-entitlement claims, not dismissal merits.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal-merits remedy; disadvantage compensation and wage arrears were ordered.

case_name: JULIETTE DARNLEY v THE CHIEF OF THE NEW ZEALAND DEFENCE FORCE
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Ms Darnley was constructively dismissed from her employment.
review_notes: Constructive-dismissal grievance succeeded. Serious-misconduct allegations and the preliminary employer finding were second-reviewed; the Authority found the disciplinary handling fundamentally unfair and did not adopt a final serious-misconduct merits finding.
remedies_awarded: $25,000 compensation; offset of three days' net salary overpayment.

case_name: TONY GORE v COLOR IT (2010) LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The unjustified-disadvantage grievance and penalty claim were withdrawn as out of time; the determination quantified KiwiSaver arrears.
review_notes: Money/entitlement determination with no dismissal merits decision.

case_name: CHARLES AKUBUO v GENERAL DISTRIBUTORS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Mr Akubuo sufficiently raised a grievance about his resignation; costs were reserved until after the substantive issues were determined.
review_notes: The determination decided only whether the constructive-dismissal grievance was raised in time, not its merits.

case_name: ADRIAN ROTTIER v CONCRETE STRUCTURES (NZ) LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Adrian Rottier was unjustifiably suspended and unjustifiably dismissed by Concrete Structures (NZ) Limited.
review_notes: Express successful dismissal finding. Drug/serious-misconduct material and s 124 were second-reviewed; the Authority found no reliable evidence of impairment and no culpable contribution warranting reduction.

case_name: GRAEME MURRAY WATTS v NGATI PAHAUWERA COMMERCIAL DEVELOPMENT LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Mr Watts' dismissal on the grounds of redundancy constitutes an unjustified dismissal.
review_notes: Express successful redundancy-dismissal finding; second review confirmed no contribution.

case_name: MICHELLE BRADLEY v HOOF CAMP SADDLERY LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Hoof Camp Saddlery Limited unjustifiably dismissed Ms Michelle Bradley.
review_notes: Express successful dismissal finding; second review confirmed no contribution.
remedies_awarded: $15,000 compensation; no lost-wage award due mitigation findings.

case_name: LILLIAN WAITERE v CCS DISABILITY ACTION WAIKATO INCORPORATED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: I do not find Ms Waitere was constructively dismissed. Ms Waitere's claim to have been constructively dismissed has not been established.
review_notes: Constructive-dismissal grievance failed even though a separate unjustified-disadvantage grievance succeeded.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal remedy; $7,500 compensation was for the separate disadvantage grievance.

case_name: TARA TWINING v LUGGATE HOTEL 2016 LTD
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: There was no breach that would support a constructive dismissal claim and all of Ms Twining's claims are dismissed.
review_notes: Constructive-dismissal grievance failed.

case_name: EDWARD REMIHANA v RIGWELD ENGINEERING LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: No dismissal had occurred and Mr Remihana was not unjustifiably dismissed by Rigweld.
review_notes: The Authority found resignation rather than dismissal. Serious-misconduct allegations arising from the drug test were second-reviewed; no dismissal occurred before resignation.

case_name: WAYDE VERMUELEN v MIKES TRANSPORT WAREHOUSE LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Mr Vermuelen was unjustifiably dismissed from Modern Transport Engineers Limited.
review_notes: Express successful dismissal finding; second review confirmed no contribution.
remedies_awarded: $13,747.50 lost wages and $10,000 dismissal compensation; separate $3,000 disadvantage compensation.

case_name: RACHEL DIMOLINE v THERMO FISHER SCIENTIFIC NEW ZEALAND LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: The Authority found a contractual redundancy situation and unjustified disadvantage, then stated there was no need to consider whether Ms Dimoline was unjustifiably constructively dismissed.
review_notes: Constructive-dismissal merits were expressly not decided; successful findings were redundancy entitlement and disadvantage.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal-merits remedy; redundancy compensation, disadvantage compensation and special damages were ordered.

case_name: BRETT ARTHUR v OSS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: These flaws in the redundancy were not minor and render Mr Arthur's dismissal unjustified.
review_notes: Express successful redundancy-dismissal finding. Direct second review confirmed no contribution; the redundancy was genuine but the process defects were material.
remedies_awarded: $52,500 lost wages, $20,000 compensation and $4,200 holiday pay.

case_name: TROYDEN EVANS v PROGRESSIVE ELECTRICS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: There has been no resolution of Mr Evans' claim nor PEL's claim and the outcome of the proceeding is unknown.
review_notes: Interlocutory strike-out/costs determination; no merits resolution.

case_name: BERHAMPORE PELETI v GENESIS 1 LTD
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Mr Peleti was constructively dismissed by G1 and Mr Peleti's dismissal by G1 was unjustified.
review_notes: Express successful constructive-dismissal finding.
remedies_awarded: $9,000.05 lost wages, $22,000 compensation, plus separate arrears/penalty/costs orders.

case_name: RAQUEL SKINNER v RESIDENTIAL MANAGEMENT LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Costs are reserved pending the conclusion of the substantive matter.
review_notes: This determination resolved preliminary timing issues only; substantive constructive-dismissal merits remained pending.

case_name: DIANE ANDERSON v PINEHAVEN COTTAGE LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Pinehaven was ordered to remedy successful unjustified-disadvantage grievances concerning training and minimum hours.
review_notes: No dismissal or constructive-dismissal merits determination.
remedies_awarded: No dismissal-merits remedy; disadvantage remedies and a good-faith penalty were ordered.

case_name: JACOB HODGSON v RURAL NETWORKS LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: His employment by GIL ended by constructive dismissal. In settlement of his personal grievance for unjustified dismissal GIL must pay remedies.
review_notes: Express successful constructive-dismissal finding.
remedies_awarded: $17,863 lost wages, $20,000 compensation, plus substantial wage/holiday/KiwiSaver/expense arrears.

case_name: CARLOS DELGADO GUEVARA v ELECTROTEC ELECTRICAL LIMITED
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: Having established his employment ended by constructive dismissal, which is a form of unjustified dismissal, Mr Delgado Guevara was entitled to remedies.
review_notes: Express successful constructive-dismissal finding. The Authority identified conduct contributing factually to the situation but found it insufficiently blameworthy to reduce remedies.
remedies_awarded: Lost wages and $14,000 compensation; no s 124 reduction.

case_name: DIPIKA MACKENZIE v HUNTINGTON’S DISEASE ASSOCIATION (AUCKLAND) INC
supporting_quote_or_paragraph: By determination [2019] NZERA 421 it was determined that Ms Mackenzie had not been constructively dismissed; this 2020 determination only dismissed her application to reopen.
review_notes: Reopening/follow-up decision; underlying dismissal merits belong to the earlier determination and must not be duplicated.
